summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept the program from running: I changed the import in `main.py` from `greetings` to `greeter` to match the real module name, and I added the missing colon to `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`. After these changes, `python3 main.py` runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world
